title: workflow/1.0/status
description: Asks for an instance's status, or answers with it on the request's thread (a body with a string state is an answer). The processor also answers start, advance, pause, resume, cancel and complete with one. (didcomm.org workflow/1.0)

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

viewer.description: Who the UI is for; derived from the connection when omitted.

instance_id.description: The workflow instance's id. The thread id MUST equal it.

state.description: The current state; pending while a start is queued and the instance doesn't exist yet.

allowed_events.description: Events whose transitions leave the current state and whose guards pass.

action_menu.description: The button and submit-button items of ui, for clients that don't render ui.

artifacts.description: Outputs of earlier actions (e.g. credential or proof exchange record ids).

ui.description: The state's UI items, filtered and bound for the viewer (when include_ui).

ui_profile.description: The UI profile used: sender (issuer side) or receiver (holder side).

participants.description: Participants by role key (issuer, holder, ...). The processor fills issuer and holder from the connection when missing.

ui_item.description: A Workflow UI 1.0 item. type picks the component; the processor applies the control keys (audience, profile, showWhen, enabledWhen, bind) and {{ JMESPath }} interpolation before it sends items in a status. Items of type button or submit-button with an event make up the action_menu. Renderers ignore types they don't know. Types the Bifold wallet renders: title, text, image, video, button, submit-button, form, text-field, check-box, checkbox, radio, drop-down, dropdown, date, slider, mcq, multiple-choice, rating, information, warning, error, pass, fail, badge, chip, chip-row, pill-row, divider, spacer, row, section, card, tile, carousel, h-scroll, timeline, basic-table, bar-chart, pie-chart, donut-chart, gauge, dial, map, calendar, share-entry.

event.description: The transition event an advance sends when the item is activated.

form-id.description: A form field's key in advance.input.

input_schema.description: On a submit-button: a JSON Schema for the form the renderer shows; the values go in advance.input, shaped by the schema.

audience.description: Shown only to a viewer matching one of: a role, participant:<key>, or a UI profile.

profile.description: Shown only for these UI profiles (sender, receiver).

showWhen.description: JMESPath over {context, participants, artifacts}; the item is dropped when falsy.

enabledWhen.description: JMESPath; when falsy the processor sets disabled: true.

bind.description: JMESPath whose result the processor puts in value.
